operations.description: Fetches a page of users who retweeted a tweet. Use the `cursor` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

tweetId.description: Numeric tweet ID to fetch retweeters for (e.g. '1234567890123456789'). Must contain only digits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to retrieve the next page of retweeters. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Fetch twitter x user followers
operations.description: Fetches a page of followers for a Twitter/X user. Use the `cursor` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

handle.description: Twitter/X handle to fetch followers for. Accepts a bare handle with or without a leading '@' (e.g. 'elonmusk' or '@elonmusk') or a full profile URL (e.g. 'https://x.com/elonmusk' or 'https://twitter.com/elonmusk').

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to retrieve the next page of followers. Omit for the first page. Use each cursor promptly to fetch the next page — cursors may become invalid if reused after a long delay.

operations.name: Fetch twitter x user following
operations.description: Fetches a page of accounts a Twitter/X user follows. Use the `cursor` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

handle.description: Twitter/X handle to fetch following accounts for. Accepts with or without a leading '@'.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to retrieve the next page. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Fetch twitter x user mentions
operations.description: Fetches a page of tweets that mention a Twitter/X user. Use the `cursor` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

handle.description: Twitter/X handle to fetch mentions for. Accepts with or without a leading '@'.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to retrieve the next page of mentions. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Fetch twitter x user tweets
operations.description: Fetches the latest tweets for a Twitter/X user. Returns a paginated list of tweets with engagement metrics. Use the `cursor` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

handle.description: Twitter/X handle to fetch tweets for. Accepts with or without a leading '@' (e.g. 'elonmusk' or '@elonmusk').

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to retrieve the next page of tweets. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Undo skip next saved search auto run
operations.description: Undo a pending skip-next-run on a saved search. The auto-spawn cron will resume considering this search for automatic runs. Idempotent: calling this when no skip is active succeeds. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

savedSearchId.description: The ID of the saved search to undo the pending skip for

operations.name: Update api key expiration
operations.description: Change the expiration of an API key. Acts on the key that authenticates this request unless target is OTHER. Choose set to pin an absolute date, extend or prepone to move the date by a number of days, or remove to make the key never expire. Once a key expires it can no longer authenticate. First-time users: create your initial API key at https://app.fiber.ai or via POST /v1/account/send-otp + veri

target.description: Which key to act on. SELF acts on the key that authenticates this request. OTHER acts on a different key in your organization, supplied in targetApiKey.

targetApiKey.description: The key to act on when target is OTHER. Must belong to your organization. You can pass prefix, id, or the raw key. Omit when target is SELF.

operation.description: set: use an absolute date. extend: push the expiration later by a number of days. prepone: pull it earlier by a number of days. remove: make the key never expire.

expiresAt.description: The new absolute expiration timestamp (ISO 8601). Required for the set operation and must be in the future; ignored otherwise.

days.description: How many days to move the expiration by. Required for the extend and prepone operations; ignored otherwise.

operations.name: Update api key credit limit
operations.description: Change the lifetime credit ceiling of an API key. Acts on the key that authenticates this request unless target is OTHER. Use set to pin an absolute limit, increase or decrease to adjust it by a number of credits, multiply or divide to scale it, or remove to make the key unlimited. Once a key's usage reaches its limit it can no longer authenticate until the limit is raised or removed. First-time u

target.description: Which key to act on. SELF acts on the key that authenticates this request. OTHER acts on a different key in your organization, supplied in targetApiKey.

targetApiKey.description: The key to act on when target is OTHER. Must belong to your organization. You can pass prefix, id, or the raw key. Omit when target is SELF.

operation.description: set: pin an absolute credit ceiling. increase/decrease: adjust the current ceiling by a number of credits. multiply/divide: scale the current ceiling by a factor. remove: make the key unlimited. increase, decrease, multiply, and divide have no effect on an already-unlimited key; use set to establish a ceiling first.

credits.description: The credit amount. Required for set (zero or greater), increase, and decrease (greater than zero); ignored otherwise.

factor.description: The factor to scale the current ceiling by. Required for multiply and divide; ignored otherwise.

operations.name: Set audience search parameters
operations.description: Updates the search parameters (filters) for an audience. You can set company filters (e.g., industry, headcount) and prospect filters (e.g., job title, location). This endpoint converts the API-friendly search parameters into the internal format used by the search engine. The audience must be in DRAFT status. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API

audienceId.description: The unique ID of the audience.

companySearchParams.description: The search parameters to filter companies.

prospectSearchParams.description: The search parameters to filter prospects.

operations.name: Update auto top up settings
operations.description: Update the organization's auto top-up configuration. Enabling auto top-up will automatically charge your organization's saved payment method via Stripe when your credit balance falls below the configured threshold. AI agents should confirm with a human operator before enabling this feature. ⚡ Rate limit: 10 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

subscriptionId.description: The subscription to configure auto top-up for. An organization can have multiple subscriptions, each with its own auto top-up settings.

creditThreshold.description: Credit balance threshold below which auto top-up triggers. Required when isEnabled is true.

creditsToBuy.description: Number of credits to purchase when auto top-up triggers. Required when isEnabled is true.

maxPerDay.description: Maximum number of auto top-ups allowed in a rolling 24-hour window. Set to null to remove the daily limit.

maxPerMonth.description: Maximum number of auto top-ups allowed per calendar month (UTC). When reached, auto top-up pauses until the next calendar month. Set to null to remove the monthly limit.

operations.name: Update job change list
operations.description: Update the name or active status of a job changes list. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

jobChangeListId.description: The ID of the job change list.

newName.description: The new name for the job change list.

isActive.description: Set the list to active or inactive.

operations.name: Update saved search
operations.description: Update a saved search ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

id.description: The ID of the saved search.

name.description: The name of the saved search. Omit to keep the current name.

spawnFrequencyDays.description: The frequency of the saved search in days. Minimum is 7 days. Omit to keep the current frequency.

companyParams.description: The company search parameters. Uses the same schema as the company search endpoint. Omit to keep the current parameters.

profileParams.description: The profile search parameters. Uses the same schema as the profile search endpoint. Omit to keep the current parameters.

isActive.description: Whether the saved search is active. Omit to keep the current status.

operations.name: Update company tracker list
operations.description: Update a company tracker list. Supports replace-all (`trackingRules`) or granular (`addRules`/`removeRuleIds`) rule management — but not both in one request. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

listId.description: The unique ID of the tracker list.

isActive.description: Pause or resume monitoring on the list.

maxDynamicMembers.description: For dynamic lists only: update the maximum number of companies to keep in the list. Lowering it applies going forward (the refresh stops adding past the new cap; existing over-cap members are not evicted). Ignored for static lists.

trackingRules.description: Replace ALL existing rules with this set. Pass empty array to clear all rules. Omit to leave unchanged. Cannot be used with `addRules`/`removeRuleIds`.

addRules.description: Add rules to the existing set without removing others. The total active rules on the list (existing + added) must not exceed the per-list cap. Cannot be used with `trackingRules`.

removeRuleIds.description: Rule IDs to remove. Cannot be used with `trackingRules`.

updateRuleFlags.description: Toggle `isDummy` on existing rules by ID. Use this to convert a real rule into a dummy rule (or vice versa) without recreating it.

initialSignals.description: When provided, generates signals immediately for recent events (funding rounds, news, job postings, social posts) without waiting for the first tracking cycle. Only certain rule types support initial signals.

operations.name: Update person tracker list
operations.description: Update a person tracker list. Supports replace-all (`trackingRules`) or granular (`addRules`/`removeRuleIds`) rule management — but not both in one request. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

listId.description: The unique ID of the tracker list.

isActive.description: Pause or resume monitoring on the list.

maxDynamicMembers.description: For dynamic lists only: update the maximum number of people to keep in the list. Lowering it applies going forward (the refresh stops adding past the new cap; existing over-cap members are not evicted). Ignored for static lists.

trackingRules.description: Replace ALL existing rules with this set. Pass empty array to clear all rules. Omit to leave unchanged. Cannot be used with `addRules`/`removeRuleIds`.

addRules.description: Add rules to the existing set without removing others. The total active rules on the list (existing + added) must not exceed the per-list cap. Cannot be used with `trackingRules`.

removeRuleIds.description: Rule IDs to remove. Cannot be used with `trackingRules`.

updateRuleFlags.description: Toggle `isDummy` on existing rules by ID. Use this to convert a real rule into a dummy rule (or vice versa) without recreating it.

initialSignals.description: When provided, generates signals immediately for recent events (funding rounds, news, job postings, social posts) without waiting for the first tracking cycle. Only certain rule types support initial signals.

operations.name: Update webhook endpoint
operations.description: Update a webhook endpoint. Change its URL, replace the event types it is subscribed to, update its description, or pause and resume delivery. Only the fields you provide are changed. Updating webhooks is free. ⚡ Rate limit: 60 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: FREE! No credits are charged for this API. ⓘ

endpointId.description: The unique ID of the webhook endpoint.

url.description: A new HTTPS URL to receive event payloads.

eventTypes.description: A new set of event types to subscribe this endpoint to.

description.description: A new human-readable label for this endpoint.

disabled.description: Set to true to pause delivery, or false to resume it.

operations.name: Validate a single phone number
operations.description: Validates a phone number and returns detailed information including whether it's valid, reachable (active/alive), carrier information, and the caller ID name associated with the number. ⚡ Rate limit: 60 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 3 credits per phone validation ⓘ ⏱ Recommended timeout: 1 minute ⓘ

phoneNumber.description: Phone number to validate. E.164 (e.g. +14155551234) is recommended; other formats with spaces, dashes, or parentheses are accepted.

patience.description: How long to wait for phone-number verification after a number is found. Higher patience increases average response time but improves identity and reachability accuracy. MINIMUM is the least thorough verification option.

operations.name: Capture webpage screenshot
operations.description: Captures a screenshot of a public webpage and returns a hosted image URL. Supports both viewport-only and full-page captures. The returned URL is permanent and does not expire. ⚡ Rate limit: 60 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per screenshot ⓘ ⏱ Recommended timeout: 1 minute ⓘ

url.description: The URL of the webpage to capture (e.g. 'https://stripe.com/pricing'). Bare domains like 'stripe.com' are also accepted and will be treated as HTTPS.

fullPage.description: If true, captures the entire scrollable page. Defaults to false (viewport only).

format.description: Device format for the capture. 'mobile' uses a phone-sized viewport, 'desktop' uses a standard widescreen viewport. Defaults to 'desktop'.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for geo-located capture (e.g. 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). If omitted, defaults to a US-based capture.

operations.name: Get a yelp business page
operations.description: Get detailed information about a Yelp Place. Search for Yelp places via /yelp/search endpoint. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per business page ⓘ

placeId.description: Yelp business ID, or the business slug from its yelp.com page (e.g. 'juniors-restaurant-new-york-9').

operations.name: Get yelp business reviews
operations.description: Get reviews of a Yelp business, paginated, with reviewer details, ratings, and full review text. Obtain the business ID via the /yelp/search endpoint. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per reviews page ⓘ

placeId.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'U5hCNNyJmb7f3dmC1HTzSQ'). Obtain it from the `placeId` of a result returned by the Yelp search endpoint (`POST /v1/yelp/search`).

sortBy.description: Sort criterion for reviews. 'relevance' is the platform's default ranking. 'elitesFirst' puts reviews from elite reviewers first. Omit to sort by relevance.

ratings.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings (e.g. [5] for five-star reviews only, [5, 4] for five- and four-star reviews). Omit (or pass []) to include all ratings.

keywords.description: Only return reviews whose text matches these keywords (e.g. ['crust', 'delivery']). Omit (or pass []) to include all reviews.

languageCode.description: Language for review text (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit for English.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a prior reviews response's `nextPageToken`. Omit (or pass null) to fetch the first page.

operations.name: Search yelp businesses
operations.description: Searches Yelp for businesses matching a query in a location, and returns matching businesses with ratings, review counts, and contact details. ⚡ Rate limit: 120 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per search ⓘ

categories.description: Categories or terms to search for (e.g. ['pizza', 'italian'] or ['coffee shop']). A business name ('Sushi Ran') also works as a term. Omit (or pass []) to browse all businesses in the location.

location.description: Where to search. Accepts a city and state ('Austin, TX'), a full address ('706 Mission St, San Francisco, CA'), or a ZIP code ('94103').

sortBy.description: Sort criterion for results. 'relevance' ranks by overall match. 'highestRated' sorts by rating. 'mostReviewed' sorts by review count. Omit to sort by relevance.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a prior search response's `nextPageToken`. Omit (or pass null) to fetch the first page.

operations.name: Fetch you tube channel info and videos
operations.description: Fetches metadata and videos for a YouTube channel. Returns subscriber count, description, video count, total views, and a paginated list of videos. Use `nextPageToken` from the response to paginate through additional video pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 60 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

channelIdentifier.description: YouTube channel @handle, channel ID, or full channel URL. Accepts a @handle (e.g. '@veritasium'), a channel ID (e.g. 'UCBcRF18a7Qf58cCRy5xuWwQ'), or a URL (e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/@veritasium').

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response to retrieve the next page of channel videos. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Search you tube videos
operations.description: Searches YouTube for videos matching a query. Returns video titles, links, channel information, view counts, and durations. ⚡ Rate limit: 60 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

query.description: The search query string to find YouTube videos (e.g. 'React Hooks tutorial').

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response to retrieve the next page of search results. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Fetch you tube video transcript
operations.description: Fetches the timestamped transcript for a YouTube video. Returns all transcript segments and the list of languages available. Provide a full YouTube URL or a bare 11-character video ID. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per request ⓘ

videoId.description: YouTube video ID or full URL. Accepts a bare 11-character ID (e.g. '094y1Z2wpJg') or a full YouTube URL (e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=094y1Z2wpJg').

languageCode.description: Transcript BCP-47 language code (e.g. 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French, 'pt-BR' for Brazilian Portuguese). Omit to receive the default language transcript.

operations.name: Fetch you tube video comments
operations.description: Fetches a page of comments for a YouTube video. Returns comment text, author, like count, and reply count. Use `nextPageToken` from the response to paginate through additional pages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per page of results ⓘ

videoId.description: YouTube video ID or full URL. Accepts a bare 11-character ID (e.g. '094y1Z2wpJg') or a full YouTube URL (e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=094y1Z2wpJg').

nextPageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response to retrieve the next page of comments. Omit for the first page.

operations.name: Fetch you tube video details
operations.description: Fetches detailed metadata for a YouTube video including title, view count, like count, channel information, chapters, key moments, and available transcript languages. ⚡ Rate limit: 300 requests per 1 minute 💰 Cost: 2 credits per request ⓘ

videoId.description: YouTube video ID or full URL. Accepts a bare 11-character ID (e.g. '094y1Z2wpJg') or a full YouTube URL (e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=094y1Z2wpJg').
